decisions.decision: The group agreed that Julie Belliveau and Nancy O’Rourke should continue assessing the new option (start the grid at $15.50, keep 3% steps, adjust several grades), including its cost to FY2024.
decisions.quote: the group agreed that she and nancy should continue their assessment of this option including the cost to fy2024.

decisions.decision: The committee identified several roles to recommend for a raise to their SAP grade levels: Library Page (Grade 1 to 2), COA Meal Site Manager (Grade 6 to 7), COA Outreach Coordinator (Grade 7 to 8).
decisions.quote: the committee identified several roles that they would recommend be considered for a raise to their sap grade levels.

decisions.decision: PACC Manager role deferred; to be examined at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: that role will be examined at the next meeting.

decisions.decision: The committee supported amending the SAP sick leave policy to include similar language to the School Union policy on childbirth/adoption use of sick time for the non-birthing parent. J. Belliveau will propose language.
decisions.quote: the committee agreed there was not reason to have different applications of this process and supported that the sap policy be amended to include similar language.

decisions.decision: J. Belliveau to propose new sick leave policy language, to be reviewed at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: j. belliveau will propose new language to this policy.

decisions.decision: The committee agreed to examine vacation time management for a potential fall warrant.
decisions.quote: the committee acknowledged the job description project had taken the majority of its focus, but agreed to examine for a potential fall warrant.

decisions.decision: Next meeting set for Wednesday March 13, 2024, to include final grid options, final outliers, sick policy review, Town Meeting warrant articles, and delivery of proposal to Select Board.
decisions.quote: next meeting, wednesday march 13, 2024 will include final assessment of options for new fy24 & fy25 sap salary grids

budget_items.topic: Grid option 1: drop Step one, keep 3% alignment
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dropping Step one with the 3% alignment was estimated to cost about $49.7K retroactive to the FY2024 SAP salary budget.
budget_items.quote: resulted in approximately $49.7k retroactive cost to the fy2024 sap salary budget.

budget_items.topic: Grid option 2: start grid at $15.30 per hour
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Starting the grid at $15.30 per hour with 3% steps was estimated at about $78.6K retroactive to the FY2024 SAP salary budget; the group felt it might not be enough.
budget_items.quote: the next option was to start the grid at $15.30 per hour and keep the 3% step alignment resulted in approximately $$78.6k retroactive cost to the fy2024 sap salary budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dropping Grade one (upgrading its employees to Grade two) was estimated at about $22.2K retroactive to the FY2024 SAP salary budget; the group felt it did not move the grid forward.
budget_items.quote: that option resulted in approximately $22.2k retroactive cost to the fy2024 sap salary budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Julie Belliveau offered a new option starting the grid at $15.50 with 3% steps and adjusted upper grades; its FY2024 cost was to be assessed.
budget_items.quote: julie belliveau offered a new option that would start the grid at $15.50, keeping the 3% step alignment
